summary: Walkthrough contract and importer design, local acquisition/transcription choices, and default-off preview integration. Canonical guides own operating behavior.
limits: The documented historical model spike is retained. Integration source and fixtures are reviewed; synthesized narration, human-speech accuracy, platform loading and published artifacts are distinct claims. No promotion to a hardened capability.
checks: Focused contract, importer, route, SDK, CLI, MCP and Activity suites; live provider/device/release qualification remains separate.
